The '''Frommon system''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Frommon [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] model known as the [[Frommon longhaul all-purpose transport]], which was featured in "[[Disturbance in the Force (article)|Disturbance in the Force]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Chris Hind]] and published in the [[November]] [[1992]] [[Challenge 66|sixty-sixth issue]] of the [[Challenge (magazine)|''Challenge'']] magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Disturbance">{{ChallengeCite|66|Disturbance in the Force (article)}}</ref> The adventure is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
